title: Something just happened
subtitle: Catch a reaction while it's still warm. Thirty seconds.

steps.title: Something just landed. What happened?
steps.body: A few words is plenty. You're not solving it — just catching it before it fades.

steps.title: Where do you feel it right now?
steps.body: The body usually knows before the words arrive.
One breath. You caught it — that's the whole move right now. The rest can wait.

exit.body: Caught in the moment — that's the real practice. It's saved, and it'll be here when you want to sit with it properly.
